## Greenspace OS 1.0.1: a calmer dashboard

The dashboard is now just the overview of your rooms. Everything you enter or set up moved to two new pages.

**Dashboard**
- Rooms with readings, lights and fertigation, and your outputs (Turn on/off and Back to automatic stay here).
- Each room shows its run ("Run 4 · Flower · day 23 · last pH …") and links to the Grow page.
- New boards are announced with "New boards waiting → Set up".

**Grow** (new, in the top bar)
- Start, flip, harvest, drying done and scrap runs; log pH / EC; edit plants; recent activity per room; finished runs.
- **Flip now also sets the light times and fertigation cycle** (filled in with the current ones). The flip and the new
  times are saved together.
- Strains are a tab on this page.

**Settings** (new, in the top bar)
- Rooms: climate limits, light times, fertigation, automation, nutrient containers. New: rename the facility, add a
  room, rename a room.
- Boards: set up new boards, edit or remove boards in use.
- MQTT broker, Database & backups, Updates ("Update now" lives here now), Account (change the admin password).

Nothing changes in how the plant is controlled: automation, commands and the database stay the same. No installer
needed: "Update now" is enough.
